floorPlans.label: Nshama Symphony on The Park apartment plans
floorPlans.introduction: Compare the one-, two- and three-bedroom layouts published by Nshama.
floorPlans.selectorLabel: Choose a Symphony on The Park apartment layout
floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Area ranges follow the printed values. The 2 BR Type B suite values run opposite to the printed total order. The selector uses the published total columns. Confirm the size of the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 7 Nshama design renders and 5 actual construction photos from the developer’s September 2026 project update. The original dated photographs have embedded side borders. The hero and card use the full-width developer exterior render. An image of a kitchen also appears in the Aria update and was excluded from both galleries.
review.location: The Nshama master-plan panel and community estimate table are on physical pages 3 and 7. The project pin is from Continental Club’s project 2786 listing and aligns with the marked plot sector. The separate reused locator in the page schema was excluded.
review.floorPlans: 7 complete sheets, with totals visually checked against the original drawing panels. The 2 BR Type B suite values run opposite to the printed total order. The selector uses the published total columns. Pages 1 and 9 are title and contact pages. The selectable layouts use pages 2–8.

unavailable: Verified visitor entrance, finished-building photos and current unit-specific measured areas.
